question: What claim about a class of figures is at stake in grouping innate, family-born, and all-door-guardian figures together?
premises: A class of innate figures is in view.
A class of family-born figures is in view.
A class of door guardians is in view as applying to all.
inference: Innate figures, family-born figures, and all door guardians form related classes in this context.
uncertainties: The unity of these classes is asserted but not explained by this verse alone.
plain_english: All innate ones, all family-born ones, and all door guardians.
